LLM auditresponse for clippy.patch:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The provided file is a patch (`clippy.patch`) modifying a TypeScript configuration file (`forge.config.ts`) used by Electron Forge to package an Electron application. The changes disable Linux-specific package makers (`MakerDeb` and `MakerRpm`) in both the import and instantiation sections, while extending `MakerZIP` to include Linux as a target platform. This could indicate a shift toward distributing only ZIP-based binaries for Linux instead of Debian/RPM packages.

These modifications are consistent with legitimate packaging decisions and do not introduce any suspicious behavior. There is no execution of external scripts, network requests, obfuscated code, or system modifications. The use of commented-out imports and constructors is standard practice when disabling functionality. No data exfiltration, backdoors, or unauthorized operations are present or implied.

The patch affects only the build configuration and does not alter runtime behavior in a malicious way. All changes are transparent and within the scope of normal Electron app packaging workflows.
</details>
